name: zbhaga
description: zBhaga - shared group expenses, split fairly.

scripts.setup: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test -w @zbhaga/shared && npm run test -w @zbhaga/api
scripts.test:cucumber: npm run cleanup:before-test && cucumber-js tests/e2e/features --require-module ts-node/register --format progress-bar --format html:cucumber-report.html --format json:cucumber-report.json && npm run cleanup:after-test
scripts.test:cucumber:feature: npm run cleanup:before-test && cucumber-js tests/e2e/features/denver-trip.feature --require-module ts-node/register --format progress-bar --format html:cucumber-report.html && npm run cleanup:after-test
scripts.test:cucumber:archive: npm run test:cucumber:feature -- && npm run cleanup:archive
scripts.test:all: npm run test:playwright -- tests/denver-trip-scenario.spec.ts && npm run test:cucumber && npm run cleanup:after-test
